summary: Antonelli arrives in Baku hunting to extend his championship lead against a field hungry to capitalize on any gaps, while McLaren's alarming pace deficit in practice threatens to derail their constructors' push against rivals. Hadjar's return from a three-race wrist injury injects unpredictability into Red Bull's strategy as the team scrambles to reclaim momentum on Baku's high-speed street circuit. A dominant performance from the championship leader could prove decisive in stretching his title advantage, or conversely, a slip could crack open the season's closing chapters.
